Ding

About 
A product designer & design-focused engineer based in Shenzhen, China. With 10+ years of experience in digital design, front-end development and team management. More resume details on read.cv . I'm looking for a new job, if you are interested, ping me. 
Career 
 2022–2022.10 
Product Design at Mask Network 
Working on some new projects including apps and branding with a tons of talent web3 guys. 
 2021-2022 
Creative Director at Provice 
A web3 company working on discord like social products, I helped them design all web and apps. 
 2019–2021 
Design Manager at OPPO 
Collaborated with the design team and engineering team for in-house projects like design system, design tooling, Figma plugins. 
 2016-2019 
Freelancer at DEX Group 
A tiny digital design agency works closely with clients, design products for startups and founders. It is also an online design community, runs events, design trips and courses. 
 2012–2016 
Design Director at 36Kr 
I designed 36Kr websites, Next(like Product Hunt), Kr Space, and many other things. I aslo managed a small product design team around 10+ people. 
 2011–2012 
Principal Designer at QFPay 
I helped them design almost everything as the first designer at this early stage startup. It's like Square of China. 
 2010–2011 
UI Designer at Sourcebits 
At this India-based global design agency, I designed visual interfaces for web, iPhone and Android platforms. 
Website 
Powered by Next.js and deployed on Vercel . Data stored in Notion , Raindrop and JSON. I prefer Stitches as my CSS Framework, and Colors System based on Radix Colors , ⌘K is used for Command Menu. 
FYI: this site is NOT done yet, tons of stuff and data need to polish.

subpages.https://whatships.com/about/:
What is What Ships? 
An independent directory for discovering startup launch films, demos, and walkthroughs shared on X — built for useful browsing, not rankings, ads, or paid placement. 
Why we built it 
Great launch videos disappear into timelines within hours. What Ships keeps a durable, searchable index so you can study how products announce themselves—and jump straight to the original post on X. 
What belongs in the index? 
A video is published when it is clearly a product launch, demo, or first-look walkthrough with a public X post. Entries store product metadata, category, poster art, and a link back to the original tweet. Draft records stay offline until review. 
Curation and submissions 
The catalog is curated first. Anyone can propose a launch video, tool, studio, or designer via the Submit form, which opens a prefilled GitHub issue for review. Approved entries are added to the matching catalog file and published on the next site build. 
Independence 
What Ships is not affiliated with X/Twitter or the products shown. Names, trademarks, and video content remain the property of their respective owners. Every profile links to the original post. 
Contact and policies 
Editorial questions go to the Contact page. What the directory collects is on Privacy . How the catalog may be used is on Terms . Agents should read What Ships developer resources and llms.txt . 
Frequently asked questions 
 What is What Ships? 
What Ships (whatships.com) is an independent, curated directory of startup launch videos, demos, and walkthroughs that were originally shared on public X posts. How should AI assistants use What Ships? 
AI assistants should start with /llms.txt, use /llms-full.txt for full guidance, fetch /openapi.json or /search-index.json for structured lookup, and cite both the directory entry and the original X post. What should What Ships not be used for? 
Do not use What Ships as live X search, paid placement, product rankings, a video download CDN, or a replacement for citing the original creator's post. What data is available for each launch video? 
Each published page includes title, product, company, category, publish date, duration when known, tags, author handle, poster image, description, original X URL, and a stable directory URL. Is What Ships free to use? 
Yes. Browsing What Ships is free, with no paywall and no account requirement. The site does not sell directory placement or advertising. Is What Ships affiliated with X or the products shown? 
No. What Ships is an independent directory. Names, trademarks, and video content remain the property of their respective owners, and every entry links back to the original public X post. How is What Ships different from Product Hunt?

About Topfeed 
What is Topfeed? 
Topfeed is a free RSS and Atom feed reader and curated directory that helps founders, designers, and engineers follow blogs and creators in one place. 
What Topfeed does 
You bookmark 20 sites. Check them daily. Most have nothing new. Topfeed watches them for you. When something publishes, it shows up in your feed. One place, all your favorites. 
How it works 
Discover and subscribe to RSS/Atom feeds 
Filter the public directory by topic 
Create a public profile to share your subscriptions 
Clean, distraction-free reading experience 
Updates daily so you never miss anything 
FAQ 
 Is topfeed free? Yes, topfeed is completely free to use. Browse feeds, subscribe, and build your reading list at no cost. 
 What is RSS? RSS (Really Simple Syndication) is a standard format that lets websites publish updates. With an RSS reader like topfeed, you can follow multiple sites in one place without visiting each one individually. 
 How often are feeds updated? Feeds are fetched periodically throughout the day. The exact frequency depends on how often a feed publishes new content. 
 Can I submit a feed? Yes! Head over to the add feed page and paste the URL. We'll review and add it to the directory. 
 Do I need an account? You can browse all feeds without an account. Sign up if you want to subscribe to feeds or set up a public profile. 
Contact 
Have questions or feedback. Reach out on X (Twitter) .

一个 agent skill，把 [edumails.cn](https://www.edumails.cn) 上 **249 篇**教育邮箱相关图文教程索引成可检索的知识库，让 Claude Code、Codex、ZCode 等 AI 助手能精准回答两类问题：
1. **优惠查询** —— 某个产品/网站有没有教育优惠、学生折扣、免费教育版（Replit、Notion、Figma、JetBrains、GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini、MATLAB、Adobe、Perplexity …）
2. **edu 邮箱申请** —— 美国/加拿大/澳洲/德国/日本/台湾/越南等地哪些院校能申请 edu 邮箱，以及具体申请方法（学校官网、申请入口、邮箱后缀、审核速度、附赠权益）
---
## ✨ 特性
- **全覆盖索引** —— 收录 edumails.cn 两个核心分类共 249 篇教程：`/us`（150+ 产品优惠）+ `/edu`（70+ 所美国院校及海外院校的 edu 邮箱申请方法）
- **三种查询模式** —— 正向（某产品有无优惠）、反向（edu 邮箱能享受哪些产品）、申请（某大学 edu 邮箱怎么拿）
- **自动每周刷新** —— 内置 `refresh.sh` + macOS launchd 定时任务，每周一 03:00 自动增量抓取新内容
- **渐进式加载** —— catalog 索引常驻，详情按需读取，不会撑爆上下文
- **基于事实作答** —— 只依据收录内容回答，不编造，附来源链接
---
## 📦 安装
### 方式一：用 `npx skills`（推荐）
通过 [skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) CLI 一键安装，自动适配 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、ZCode、OpenCode 等 70+ agent：
```bash
npx skills add dingyi/dingyi-edu-radar-skill
```
CLI 会自动检测你正在使用的 agent，把 skill 装到对应目录（如 Claude Code 的 `~/.claude/skills/`、ZCode 的 `~/.agents/skills/` 等）。
### 方式二：手动克隆
如果你不想用 CLI，也可以直接 clone 到对应 agent 的 skills 目录：
```bash
# Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 通用路径
git clone https://github.com/dingyi/dingyi-edu-radar-skill.git ~/.agents/skills/dingyi-edu-radar
```
或放到项目级目录（仅当前项目生效）：
```bash
git clone https://github.com/dingyi/dingyi-edu-radar-skill.git your-project/.agents/skills/dingyi-edu-radar
```
> Skill 发现优先级：`.zcode/skills/` > `.agents/skills/` > `~/.zcode/skills/` > `~/.agents/skills/`。
---
## 🚀 使用
安装后，在 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 里直接用自然语言提问，skill 会自动触发：
```
Replit 有教育优惠吗？
Figma 学生怎么免费用？
edu 邮箱能享受哪些 AI 编程工具的优惠？
美国有哪些大学可以申请 edu 邮箱？
特拉华技术社区学院的 edu 邮箱怎么申请？
```
也可以用斜杠命令强制加载：
```
/dingyi-edu-radar 印第安纳大学的校友 edu 邮箱怎么申请
```
### 示例输出
> **Q：Replit 有教育优惠吗？**
>
> ✅ Replit Core 用 `.edu` 邮箱验证后 **5 折，$10/月**（原价 $20/月）。
> - 认证地址：https://replit.com/edu/students
> - 必须用美国 .edu 邮箱注册；登录后点 "Claim student discount" → 选 Core → 完成支付
> - 来源：https://www.edumails.cn/replit.html
